notablePrerequisites: An opponent has lost life this turn.
easyPrerequisites: Iceberg has at least one ice counter on it.
description:
Cast Burning-Tree Emissary by paying its mana cost.
Inexorable Tide and Equilibrium trigger.
Resolve the Inexorable Tide trigger, causing you to proliferate, thus putting an ice counter on Iceberg.
Holding priority, activate Iceberg's second ability by removing an ice counter, adding {C}.
Resolve the Equilibrium trigger, causing you to pay {1} to return Flamecache Gecko from the battlefield to your hand.
When Burning-Tree Emissary enters, it triggers, adding {R}{G}.
Cast Flamecache Gecko by paying its mana cost.
Inexorable Tide and Equilibrium trigger.
Resolve the Inexorable Tide trigger, causing you to proliferate, thus putting an ice counter on Iceberg.
Holding priority, activate Iceberg's second ability by removing an ice counter, adding {C}.
Resolve the Equilibrium trigger, causing you to pay {1} to return Burning-Tree Emissary from the battlefield to your hand.
When Flamecache Gecko enters, it triggers, adding {B}{R}.
Repeat.
